scoreRecord.thesis: CoreWeave is a direct AI-compute infrastructure beneficiary with exceptional contracted demand, but its economics are inseparable from aggressive capital formation and GPU/power availability.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Leverage and capital intensity can overwhelm backlog growth if deployment timing, utilization, customer concentration or financing conditions deteriorate.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Q3 2026 backlog conversion, financing cost and active-power deployment progress.
